name: Acoustic Levitation Rig
artDescription: Pixel-art open teal laboratory frame with two facing circular speaker plates and three tiny silver beads floating between them.

name: Laboratory Centrifuge
artDescription: Pixel-art cream laboratory centrifuge with an open round blue lid and a silver rotor holding six red-capped sample tubes.

name: Benchtop Spectrometer
artDescription: Pixel-art navy benchtop spectrometer with a glass prism chamber, a tiny rainbow beam and a bright multicolor spectrum screen.

name: Thermal Imaging Camera
artDescription: Pixel-art black handheld thermal camera with a chunky orange grip and a display showing a vivid red-yellow-blue hand silhouette.

name: Underwater Inspection ROV
artDescription: Pixel-art yellow underwater inspection robot with four shrouded propellers, a front camera dome and a long coiled orange tether.

name: Tilt-Rotor Airship
artDescription: Pixel-art silver cigar-shaped airship with blue solar stripes, a small cream gondola and four red tilting propeller pods.

name: Electric Cargo Tricycle
artDescription: Pixel-art mint electric cargo tricycle with two front wheels around a deep wooden-look cargo box and a black rear battery.

name: Cable Camera Gondola
artDescription: Pixel-art small red camera gondola hanging beneath twin overhead rollers on a silver cable, with a black swiveling camera underneath.

name: Portable Electric Winch
artDescription: Pixel-art blue portable electric winch with a thick tan rope spool, silver hook, black motor housing and red battery pack.

name: Folding Electric Scooter
artDescription: Pixel-art coral folding electric scooter with two black wheels, a broad dark deck and a silver handlebar stem folded at its hinge.

artDescription: Pixel-art tall violet vending machine with a glass front displaying colorful canned food, cream selection buttons and a black delivery slot.

name: Magnetic Stirring Hotplate
artDescription: Pixel-art cream laboratory hotplate with a black ceramic top and a clear flask swirling blue liquid around a tiny white stir bar.

name: Recirculating Water Chiller
artDescription: Pixel-art blue recirculating chiller with a vented cream front, two clear looping hoses and a frosty silver reservoir cap.

artDescription: Pixel-art thick silver pressure chamber with a round blue viewing window, eight perimeter bolts and a red top pressure wheel.

artDescription: Pixel-art short silver sorting conveyor with a blue belt, an overhead red scanner and three small colored sorting bins.

artDescription: Pixel-art cream electric grain mill with a wide steel funnel hopper, round grinding housing and a blue collection cup.

artDescription: Pixel-art white articulated magnifying lamp with a large circular blue lens, a glowing LED rim and two spring-loaded arms.

artDescription: Pixel-art silver automatic label applicator with a large white label reel, orange guide rollers and a narrow blue conveyor.

name: Music Roll Puncher
artDescription: Pixel-art brass music-roll punching machine with two cream paper reels and a row of tiny silver punches above dotted paper.

artDescription: Pixel-art ornate walnut miniature theater with red curtains, a blue starry backdrop and three jointed clockwork figures on its stage.

name: Desktop Jacquard Loom
artDescription: Pixel-art wooden desktop loom with a row of blue servo blocks, many vertical cream threads and a partly woven red geometric cloth.

name: Immersive Flight Simulator
artDescription: Pixel-art compact dark-blue flight simulator cockpit with a wraparound curved screen, red pilot seat, control stick and silver motion base.
